name: X05: host-rolled guest defence carries Best Creature survivability (co-op parity)
claim: encounter_director._creature_card now passes is_best and the species' Best Creature ability to effective_defence, as combat_manager's solo hit path does, and re-announces the card when the title moves while the creature stays deployed. Two peers: the host reads the card it holds for the guest (the defence host_pick_struck_participant hands to every host-rolled blow) and compares it with the solo reference rebuilt from the card's species and level, before, during and after the guest designates its deployed Terrapup. Setup: production deploy/adopt only; no fixtures.

steps.label: host production summon (a creature out on both sides)
guest production summon/adopt of the Terrapup starter; its card is announced to the host
BASELINE: guest creature not designated -- host card defence equals plain solo effective defence
guest designates its deployed Terrapup Best Creature (party toggle)
PARITY: host card defence now equals the solo Best Creature survivability defence (shell_guard +15%) -- the number every host-rolled blow on the guest uses
PARITY: the refreshed card drops the bonus
